title: fix(plugin-approvals)!: a request with no submitter is recalled, reminded or resubmitted only by the system or the override actor
body:
Clause-②: no (narrowing) — FROM: on a request whose `submitter_id` is empty, `recall`, `remind` and `resubmit` admitted every caller who could read the request. TO: such a request is recalled only by a system context or the override actor (on `pending`), and reminded or resubmitted only by a system context; every other caller gets the door's existing non-submitter refusal (`403 FORBIDDEN`, same sentence). A request that has a submitter is unchanged.
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：没有提交人的审批请求（由无用户的触发器发起），撤回、催办、重新提交只允许系统上下文和覆盖管理员，与各入口今天的放行范围一致。
- 为什么改：这三个入口的契约是「仅提交人（或系统 / 覆盖管理员）」；能看到请求不等于能操作请求。
- 风险与回滚：只收窄这三个入口在「无提交人」时的放行集合，有提交人的请求行为不变；回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/approval-service.ts`（新判定 `actsAsSubmitter` 与三处守卫）、`approval-service.test.ts` 新 describe、dogfood 新 describe。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-approvals exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/approval-service.test.ts -t 'no submitter'`，预期 4 个测试全过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地（收窄臂，需席位合同级复核）。

## What changes

- **The rule.** A request with no submitter is recalled, reminded or resubmitted only by the system or the override actor. One predicate, `actsAsSubmitter(raw, actorId)`, now answers "is this caller the submitter" for all three doors, and it answers no for every actor when the request names no submitter. Each door keeps its other arms exactly as before:
  - `recall`: a system context and the override actor on a `pending` request (the `returned` reach stays the submitter's alone, as `IApprovalService.recall` documents);
  - `remind` (pending) and `resubmit` (returned): a system context.
- **The refusal** is each door's existing non-submitter refusal, unchanged: same code (`FORBIDDEN`), same sentence. No new error code.
- **Unchanged.** A request that has a submitter is judged exactly as before. Read visibility, decide, send back, reassign, request information and comment are untouched.
- **Entry points judged** (every read of `submitter_id` in the service):
  - `comment`: `isSubmitter` is false when no submitter, so a caller off the slate is refused. It already fails closed, so it is not the same class and is not changed.
  - decide's `excludeSubmitter` check, `excludedSubmitterSlots` and `assertReassignTargetIsNotSubmitter`: these exclude the submitter. With no submitter, nobody is excluded, which is correct. Not the same class.
  - The viewer flag `is_submitter` requires a non-null submitter, so it already matched the server rule this PR enforces.
  - The notification audiences only address the submitter when there is one. Not authorization.
  - The REST routes (`approvals-routes.ts`) forward to the service with the caller's own context and hold no submitter gate of their own.
- **Also:** an org-scoped submitter calling `recall`, `remind`, `resubmit` or `comment` on a request with no organization gets `404 REQUEST_NOT_FOUND` and writes nothing. That case is now pinned beside the existing approver case in the org-filtered read-back group.

## Tests

- `approval-service.test.ts`, new describe `a request with no submitter is recalled, reminded or resubmitted only by the system or the override actor`:
  - A pending approver and a record reader both read the request. Each is refused `recall` (pending and returned), `remind` and `resubmit`. The refusal is byte-equal to the one that caller gets on a request that has a submitter, and nothing is written.
  - The override actor still recalls a pending request. It is refused on `remind`, on `resubmit` and on recall of a returned request, as before.
  - A system context still recalls, reminds and resubmits.
  - Control: a request that has a submitter is recalled, reminded and resubmitted by its submitter.
- `approval-service.test.ts`, org-filtered read-back group: the org-scoped submitter case described above.
- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/approval-act-doors-read-visibility.dogfood.test.ts`, a new top-level describe at the HTTP door on a real boot, with the record-reader tier on:
  - A no-submitter request opened by a system-context record write. The pending approver and the record reader are refused `403 FORBIDDEN` on all three verbs. A plain member gets `404`. The request and its action history are unchanged.
  - Controls: a system context reminds and resubmits; the administrator recalls through the override; a request with a submitter is reminded and recalled by its submitter.
- The header of that dogfood file already names `approval-service.test.ts` as the server half on `main`, so no correction was needed.

## Acceptance notes

- Declared reading: the override actor is admitted wherever each door admits it today. That is `recall` on a pending request. It is not admitted on `remind` or `resubmit`, and not on recall of a returned request. On a request with no submitter, a system context is refused recall of a `returned` request, matching the contract that only the submitter reaches `returned`.
- No ADR-0087 D3 entry: no author's metadata is refused.
